parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

1
allot[əˈlɑt]v.
To allot something means to give it to someone.
→ The coach allotted each team five minutes to prepare a strategy.
2
appall[əˈpɔ:l]v.
To appall means to horrify, shock, or disgust someone.
→ The boy was appalled when he saw the accident.
3
cache[kæʃ]n.
A cache is a hiding place for valuable things.
→ The pirates kept their jewelry in a cache hidden in a cave.
4
convenience[kənˈvi:njəns]n.
Convenience is a state of being able to do something with little effort.
→ The Internet allows consumers to shop at their own convenience.
5
dearth[də:rθ]n.
A dearth is an amount or supply which is not large enough.
→ There is a dearth of money in my bank account. I can’t afford a new car.
6
deliberate[diˈlibərit]adj.
If a thing you do is deliberate, you intend to do it.
→ She made a deliberate effort to save money each month.
7
dire[ˈdaiər]adj.
When something is dire, it is terrible and very serious.
→ The tornado created a dire situation for the small town.
8
elapse[iˈlæps]v.
To elapse means to pass, as in seconds, minutes, or hours.
→ A few seconds must elapse before you can take another picture.
9
empathy[ˈempəθi]n.
Empathy is sharing or understanding another person’s feelings.
→ The caring nurse had empathy for her patients.
10
fanciful[ˈfænsifəl]adj.
When something is fanciful, it is unusual or unrealistic.
→ The girl had fanciful ideas about doing well in school without studying.
11
gripe[graip]v.
To gripe means to complain constantly.
→ Lawrence always gripes when he has to do chores.
12
grueling[ˈgru:əliŋ]adj.
When something is grueling, it is very hard to do.
→ The climber faced the grueling task of reaching the top of the steep mountain.
13
mundane[mʌnˈdein]adj.
When something is mundane, it is boring, common, or ordinary.
→ The man had the mundane chore of raking thousands of leaves into piles.
14
opt[ɑpt]v.
To opt is to make a choice, especially when deciding in favor of something.
→ My brother likes chocolate ice cream, but I always opt for vanilla.
15
outrage[ˈautreidʒ]n.
Outrage is a very strong emotion of anger or shock.
→ Tommy was feeling outrage when his parents said he couldn’t go to the dance.
16
paltry[ˈpɔ:ltri]adj.
When an amount of something is paltry, it is very small.
→ The poor man had a paltry sum of money.
17
rectify[ˈrektəfai]v.
To rectify something means to correct it.
→ I quickly rectified the spelling mistakes that I had on my essay.
18
resourceful[ri:ˈsɔ:rsfəl]adj.
When someone is resourceful, they are good at dealing with hard situations.
→ After his boat sunk, Matt was resourceful enough to build a raft.
19
sustenance[ˈsʌstənəns]n.
Sustenance is food and water needed to keep a person, animal, or plant alive.
→ Without the proper sustenance, the man will starve.
20
tedious[ˈti:diəs]adj.
When something is tedious, it is long, frustrating, and boring.
→ His job involved a lot of tedious typing, filing, and organizing.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: You would have empathy if you______.
questions.explanation: empathy là sự thấu cảm, tương đương với chia sẻ cảm xúc buồn (shared sad feelings).

questions.content: How would you feel if there was a dearth of food?
questions.explanation: dearth là sự thiếu hụt. Thiếu hụt thức ăn sẽ cảm thấy đói (Hungry).

questions.content: If something is a convenience, then it makes______.
questions.explanation: convenience là sự thuận tiện. Sự thuận tiện làm cho công việc dễ dàng hơn (a task easier).

questions.content: How would a resourceful person deal with a problem?
questions.explanation: resourceful là tháo vát. Người tháo vát sẽ tìm ra giải pháp (Find a solution).

questions.content: If something was deliberate, then it was______.
questions.explanation: deliberate là cố ý, có chủ đích. Cố ý nghĩa là làm có chủ đích (done on purpose).

questions.content: How would you describe someone feeling a sense of outrage?
questions.explanation: outrage là phẫn nộ, tức giận. Cảm thấy phẫn nộ đồng nghĩa với việc bực tức (Upset).

questions.content: What fanciful idea might a doctor have?
questions.explanation: fanciful là kỳ lạ, viển vông. Ý tưởng viển vông là hỏi xin lời khuyên từ tiên (Ask a fairy for advice).

questions.content: What would a tired person likely opt to do?
questions.explanation: opt là chọn. Người mệt mỏi có thể sẽ chọn đi ngủ (Go to bed).

questions.content: To rectify hurting your friend, you would___
questions.explanation: rectify là sửa chữa, khắc phục. Khắc phục việc làm tổn thương bạn là nói xin lỗi (say sorry).

questions.content: What might appall a teacher?
questions.explanation: appall là làm kinh hãi, phẫn nộ. Một giáo viên có thể bị phẫn nộ bởi thái độ thô lỗ (A mean attitude).

sections.title: Exercise 2: Choose the one that is similar in meaning to the given word.

questions.content: outrage
questions.explanation: outrage là sự phẫn nộ, tương đương với anger (sự tức giận).

questions.content: rectify
questions.explanation: rectify là sửa chữa, tương đương với to correct.

questions.content: sustenance
questions.explanation: sustenance là chất bổ dưỡng, thực phẩm, tương đương với food and drink.

questions.content: dire
questions.explanation: dire là thảm khốc, tồi tệ, tương đương với terrible.

questions.content: opt
questions.explanation: opt là lựa chọn, tương đương với to choose.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Choose the one that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

questions.content: tedious
questions.explanation: tedious là nhàm chán. Trái nghĩa là fun (vui vẻ).

questions.content: appall
questions.explanation: appall là làm kinh hãi. Trái nghĩa là to please (làm hài lòng).

questions.content: paltry
questions.explanation: paltry là ít ỏi, nhỏ nhặt. Trái nghĩa là large (lớn).

questions.content: grueling
questions.explanation: grueling là cực nhọc. Trái nghĩa là easy (dễ dàng).

questions.content: resourceful
questions.explanation: resourceful là tháo vát, khôn ngoan. Trái nghĩa là foolish (ngu ngốc).

sections.title: Exercise 4: Write C if the italicized word is used correctly. Write I if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: I had a big breakfast. Many hours will elapse before I feel hungry again.
questions.explanation: elapse (trôi qua). Thời gian trôi qua trước khi đói lại. Sử dụng đúng.

questions.content: Dan was a nice man, but no one would work for him because of his fanciful ideas.
questions.explanation: fanciful (viển vông). Mọi người không làm việc cho anh ta vì ý tưởng viển vông. Sử dụng đúng.

questions.content: I was very grateful for my birthday gifts. I griped about them to all of my friends.
questions.explanation: gripe (phàn nàn). Biết ơn nhưng lại phàn nàn là mâu thuẫn. Sử dụng sai.

questions.content: Because there was a dearth of food at home, the family went out to eat.
questions.explanation: dearth (sự thiếu hụt). Vì thiếu thức ăn nên ra ngoài ăn. Sử dụng đúng.

questions.content: The puppy was happy to learn new tricks. Each one was very mundane for him.
questions.explanation: mundane (nhàm chán, bình thường). Cún con vui vẻ học thủ thuật mới nên không thể là nhàm chán. Sử dụng sai.

questions.content: Mother allotted me and my brother the money. Now she had all the money.
questions.explanation: allot (phân bổ). Mẹ đã phân bổ tiền cho tôi và em trai thì mẹ không thể còn tất cả tiền. Sử dụng sai.

questions.content: The boy was proud of his trophies. He displayed them in a cache for everyone to see.
questions.explanation: cache (nơi cất giấu). Trưng bày cúp cho mọi người xem ở nơi cất giấu bí mật là vô lý. Sử dụng sai.

questions.content: Because he had planned for the trap to capture his victim, he was very deliberate.
questions.explanation: deliberate (có chủ ý, tính toán). Lên kế hoạch bẫy là hành động có chủ ý. Sử dụng đúng.

questions.content: The violent criminal was on the news this evening. His actions appalled most people.
questions.explanation: appall (làm kinh hãi). Hành động của tên tội phạm bạo lực làm kinh hãi hầu hết mọi người. Sử dụng đúng.

questions.content: That man is very selfish. He has empathy for every person he meets.
questions.explanation: empathy (sự đồng cảm). Người ích kỷ (selfish) thì không thể có sự đồng cảm với mọi người. Sử dụng sai.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Little Mice

Beth was a very resourceful and conservative mouse. She knew that winter was coming and that there would soon be a dearth of food. So she decided to make gathering food for winter her primary job. Gathering food was a grueling and mundane activity, but Beth made a deliberate effort because she knew that it was important. She allotted herself a few hours every day to collect beans. By winter, she had collected a massive pile and hid them in a cache.

Beth had a sister named Mary. Mary lacked ambition. She had fanciful ideas about how she would survive winter. She thought that food would just come to her and that she could work at her own convenience. She opted to spend the days playing and dancing, instead of gathering beans. When the final hours of autumn elapsed, Mary had only a paltry amount of food stored away.

Mary realized that her food supply was too small to last through winter. She visited her sister. Mary said, “Beth, I am in a dire situation. I didn’t gather enough food for winter. Will you let me share your beans? Please have some empathy for your sister!”

Beth thought for a moment. Then she replied, “Mary, I am truly sorry for you. But I will not give you any of my beans. Instead, I will let you have my empty bag. You can still work hard and gather enough food for the winter. It will be tedious, but you will learn the value of hard work.”

Beth’s words appalled Mary. Mary cried with outrage, “There is too much work! I won’t have any time to dance or play!”

Beth said, “It is crucial that you gather enough food. You must have sustenance before you have fun. Go now, and rectify your situation.”

Mary griped some more, but she knew that her sister was right. She took the bag and went to work gathering her own beans for the winter.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement True (T) or False (F).

questions.content: Beth was resourceful and conservative, so she gathered a paltry pile of beans for her cache.
questions.explanation: Câu này là sai. Dựa vào bài đọc ở đoạn 1 có viết "By winter, she had collected a massive pile and hid them in a cache". Beth đã thu thập được một đống thức ăn khổng lồ chứ không phải là một số lượng ít ỏi (paltry).

questions.content: Because gathering food was tedious, Beth allotted a few hours of every day to do it.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng. Theo đoạn 1 của bài đọc, "She allotted herself a few hours every day to collect beans". Beth đã dành ra vài giờ mỗi ngày để thu thập đậu.

questions.content: Beth did grueling and mundane work to overcome the dearth of food in the winter.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng. Trong đoạn 1 có ghi "Gathering food was a grueling and mundane activity... She knew that winter was coming and that there would soon be a dearth of food". Cô ấy làm công việc vất vả và nhàm chán để vượt qua sự thiếu hụt thức ăn vào mùa đông.

questions.content: Beth’s reply appalled Mary and made her reply in outrage.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng. Ở đoạn 5 có câu "Beth’s words appalled Mary. Mary cried with outrage". Lời nói của Beth đã làm Mary sửng sốt và khiến cô ấy hét lên trong sự phẫn nộ.

questions.content: When the hours of autumn elapsed, Mary had a massive amount of food.
questions.explanation: Câu này là sai. Đoạn 2 ghi rõ "When the final hours of autumn elapsed, Mary had only a paltry amount of food stored away". Mary chỉ có một lượng nhỏ thức ăn chứ không phải một lượng lớn (massive).

questions.content: What was Beth’s primary job?
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 1 có câu "So she decided to make gathering food for winter her primary job". Vì vậy công việc chính của Beth là thu thập thức ăn. Đáp án là To gather food.

questions.content: What fanciful idea did Mary opt to try?
options: She thought that food would just come to her, and she wouldn’t have to work.
She decided to plant a massive farm.
She opted to steal from her sister.
She chose to work twice as hard as Beth.
questions.explanation: Ở đoạn 2, bài đọc chỉ ra rằng "She had fanciful ideas about how she would survive winter. She thought that food would just come to her and that she could work at her own convenience". Mary có suy nghĩ viển vông rằng thức ăn sẽ tự đến với mình.

questions.content: What did Mary want her sister to have empathy about?
options: Her lack of a warm house
Mary not having anything to eat
The boring work of gathering food
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 3, Mary nói "I didn’t gather enough food for winter. Will you let me share your beans? Please have some empathy for your sister!". Mary muốn chị mình đồng cảm về việc mình không thu thập đủ thức ăn.

questions.content: How did Mary rectify her dire situation and get sustenance?
options: She cried until Beth gave her the food.
Mary took the bag and went to work gathering beans.
She found another cache of food in the forest.
She continued to play and ignore the problem.
questions.explanation: Ở đoạn cuối của câu chuyện, "She took the bag and went to work gathering her own beans for the winter". Mary đã cầm chiếc túi và tự đi thu thập đậu để khắc phục tình huống khó khăn của mình.

questions.content: Even though she griped, what did Mary know at the end of the story?
options: She knew her sister was right.
She knew winter would be short.
She knew she could find a different friend.
She knew the beans were not tasty.
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn cuối cùng, bài đọc ghi "Mary griped some more, but she knew that her sister was right". Mặc dù có phàn nàn thêm một chút, nhưng Mary biết rằng chị gái mình đã nói đúng.
